characters.default_scene_en: At a small kitchen table late at night, she holds up a forkful of freshly cooked noodles with a quietly triumphant, inviting smile. A blue ceramic bowl of noodles topped with a fried egg sits in the foreground. Frame her from the waist up at eye level; a warm pendant lamp illuminates the food, her cheeks, and the gold ornaments, with a calm window and soft darkness behind her.

fixed.character_core_en: SERA is an adult woman in her early thirties with a softly rounded yet elegant face, warm brown eyes, luminous chestnut hair gathered into a loose low updo, and a naturally curving mature figure. She has a refined, welcoming gaze and subtle gold floral hair jewelry with delicate matching earrings. Her signature outfit is an ivory blouse with a wine-red neck ribbon and a softly draped skirt in coordinated warm tones. Her visual personality combines table manners and unabashed enjoyment of simple food.
fixed.render_2d_en: Illustrate in polished 2D character art with delicate expressive lines, painterly warm shadows, clear eyes, appetizing hand-painted food, soft fabric folds, and a refined domestic color palette.
fixed.render_3d_en: Render as an appealing high-end 3D character with carefully sculpted adult facial proportions, individual chestnut hair strands gathered into a believable updo, warm subsurface skin shading, satin-gold jewelry, woven ivory cloth, ceramic glaze, and realistic steam and food materials.

characters.source_notes_ja: 髪飾りは原案のフォーク型と現画像の花型で不一致。今回は画像基準の花型を暫定採用。
characters.tagline_ja: 夜食を、最高に上品に正当化する女

characters.default_scene_en: On a wet city sidewalk just after rain, she steps past a shallow puddle while turning her head slightly toward the viewer, one shopping bag hanging loosely by her side. Use a full-body three-quarter street-fashion composition at a moderate camera height so the striking blue boots remain clearly visible. Reflections of storefronts color the pavement beneath soft overcast daylight.

fixed.character_core_en: SENA is an adult woman in her mid twenties with a long graceful neck, tall slender proportions, a precisely cut chin-length black bob, composed dark eyes, and a confident, self-chosen sense of style. Her key outfit is an oversized ivory tailored jacket over a black top, fluid black wide-leg trousers, small silver earrings, and sharply pointed cobalt-blue boots. Her sophistication feels personal rather than performative; the black bob, poised posture, and independently assessing gaze are stable identity features.
fixed.render_2d_en: Create a stylish 2D fashion illustration with crisp black contours, clean elegant silhouettes, restrained highlights, graphic reflections, strong garment shape language, and precise boot shapes.
fixed.render_3d_en: Create a premium 3D fashion-character render with tailored jacket structure, naturally weighted trouser cloth, realistic cobalt leather boots, subtle silver jewelry, a glossy but controlled bob hairstyle, and believable wet pavement reflections.

characters.source_notes_ja: 青い靴は基準デザインの強い識別点。ただし衣装変更で色が永続固定と確定したわけではない。
characters.tagline_ja: 自分の機嫌を、自分の美意識で取る女

characters.default_scene_en: In the middle of a small rehearsal studio, he practices a dramatic reaching gesture toward an imagined audience, one foot forward and the other planted, with a concentrated expression beginning to turn into an irresistible grin. Present a dynamic three-quarter full-body view with the entire gesture readable. Cool stage-blue reflections mingle with warm practice-room light.

fixed.character_core_en: YURA is a charismatic adult male stage performer with a slim athletic physique, ash-blond hair swept into long layered bangs, luminous aqua-blue eyes, fine handsome facial features, and an unabashedly self-admiring smile. He wears a pearl-white stage shirt with an open collar, an ornate sapphire-blue and pearl-toned performance jacket detailed with silver trims, slim black trousers, and polished stage shoes. His silhouette is graceful and slightly theatrical, yet his adult proportions and hardworking physicality remain clear.
fixed.render_2d_en: Make a vivid 2D stage-character illustration using elegant flowing line work, dynamic cloth shapes, bright expressive aqua eyes, selectively sparkling costume detail, and crisp directional highlights.
fixed.render_3d_en: Make an ornate stylized 3D performer render with physically grounded satin and metallic costume materials, properly articulated fingers, layered blond hair, realistic movement in the jacket, and soft theatrical stage lighting.

characters.source_notes_ja: 表情や失敗描写でも幼児化しない。
characters.tagline_ja: 努力まで堂々と見せる、自分大好きな王子

characters.default_scene_en: In a cluttered yet purposeful workshop at dusk, he delicately adjusts a tiny brass mechanism between his large fingertips while leaning over an old wooden workbench. Show a medium shot angled slightly from the side, with enough of both hands and the mechanism visible to make the action understandable. A single practical desk lamp lights the brass and his thoughtful face; workshop shelving recedes into a warm shadow.

fixed.character_core_en: GAKU is a broad-shouldered adult man in his late thirties with muscular arms, large capable hands, short untidy black hair, a little rough stubble, strong brows, and a face that softens when he concentrates. He wears a charcoal work tank top and worn muted-orange overalls tied around his waist. A few functional brass tools belong naturally with him. His defining contrast is immense physical strength paired with extremely careful, affectionate craftsmanship.
fixed.render_2d_en: Draw expressive 2D character art with robust anatomy, confident ink contours, tactile hand-painted wood and brass, warmly simplified workshop shapes, and fine attention around the fingers and machine.
fixed.render_3d_en: Render a high-quality 3D character with sculpted shoulder and arm mass, realistic rough workwear, short stubble, detailed functional brass joints and screws, and precise contact between the fingers and the mechanism.

characters.source_notes_ja: 意味のない歯車装飾で機械を埋めず、作業対象を判読可能にする。
characters.tagline_ja: 好きと言う前に、変なものを作ってしまう男

characters.default_scene_en: At the end of a stone training courtyard, she catches her breath after winning a sparring match, one gloved hand opening toward a fallen opponent just outside the frame. She smirks with measured pride, with her cape turning to reveal the yellow lining. Use a full-body low three-quarter composition, late-afternoon directional sunlight, and long shadows across the flagstones.

fixed.character_core_en: HAZUMI is a beautiful and formidable adult woman with short jet-black hair, piercing amber eyes, sharply angled brows, an athletic upper body, and sculpted strong shoulders and arms. She wears a fitted black tactical costume with discreet gold fittings, sturdy gloves, and a dramatic cape with an unmistakable bright yellow lining. Her posture conveys self-possession and a desire to make victory look beautiful. Maintain mature feminine anatomy rather than an adolescent silhouette.
fixed.render_2d_en: Produce energetic 2D action-character illustration with strong black silhouettes, precisely composed yellow accents, confident anatomy, clear cape motion, and controlled cinematic cel shading.
fixed.render_3d_en: Produce a premium stylized 3D action render with layered fitted armor textiles, metallic gold trims, naturally draping yellow-lined cape material, carefully sculpted athletic muscles, and credible grounded contact with the stone courtyard.

characters.source_notes_ja: 助ける場面も『勝ち方の美しさ』という性格の核を維持。
characters.tagline_ja: 自分の勝利を、誰より美しくしたい悪役

characters.default_scene_en: On a small intimate theater stage, she delivers a final dramatic line toward a single empty-looking front-row seat, one hand resting over her chest as a curtain pools behind her. Capture a three-quarter knee-up composition with an earnest rather than exaggerated expression. Amber footlights illuminate her face and red sleeves while the rest of the stage falls into theatrical shadow.

fixed.character_core_en: MIRA is an expressive adult theatrical woman with abundant reddish-brown wavy hair, warm animated eyes, gold floral hair ornaments, and a presence that fills a stage even without a crowd. Her distinctive costume combines a cream blouse, voluminous red sleeves, deep red wide-leg trousers, and practical stage boots. Her face is able to move from dazzling confidence to private nervousness while remaining recognizably the same grown woman.
fixed.render_2d_en: Use lush 2D theater illustration with sweeping wave-shaped hair lines, elegant red drapery, painterly warm spotlight gradients, expressive adult eyes, and deliberate stage composition.
fixed.render_3d_en: Use a sophisticated 3D character render with groomed dense wavy hair, layered theatrical fabrics, subtle skin translucency, soft volumetric stage beams, and a believable small theater set.

characters.source_notes_ja: 演じている役と本人を区別。
characters.tagline_ja: 観客が一人でも、本気で主役を張る女

characters.default_scene_en: Inside a familiar neighborhood café, he turns from a table to offer an amused, slightly conspiratorial glance, holding a hand-marked schedule while his battered bag rests on the next chair. Compose as a relaxed waist-up character portrait, with gentle morning light from the café window and warm practical interior tones.

fixed.character_core_en: ROKU is a mature man of about forty-nine with short messy black hair silvering at the temples, a neat rough beard, age lines around kind observant eyes, a naturally solid adult frame, and an easy old-friend confidence. He wears a dark navy knit top, charcoal trousers, a practical wristwatch, and a worn brown leather shoulder bag. He looks dependable without becoming stiff or overly youthful.
fixed.render_2d_en: Render warm 2D adult-character illustration with natural facial age lines, subtle knit texture, an approachable brush-and-ink finish, and soft interior light.
fixed.render_3d_en: Render grounded semi-realistic 3D character art with well-observed older facial anatomy, gray temples, subtle stubble, natural knit fabric and scuffed leather, using gentle physically based window lighting.

characters.source_notes_ja: 49歳らしい年齢表現を保持。
characters.tagline_ja: 段取りだけは完璧な、49歳の悪友

characters.default_scene_en: In a sunlit living room, she turns a spontaneous dance step while holding one side of her orange coat open, delighted with the motion. Show a full-body composition with ample space around her arms, purple fabric flowing in a clear direction, and soft golden light glancing across her silver hair and expressive mature face.

fixed.character_core_en: KIKYO is a stylish sixty-eight-year-old woman with short silvery-white hair, confident red lipstick, visible age lines at the eyes, mouth, neck, and hands, and remarkable upright posture. She wears richly colored flowing purple clothing, a vivid orange overcoat, prominent rings, and elegant shoes. Her presence is daring, lively, and glamorous precisely as an older woman; her age must remain visible in every medium.

fixed.render_3d_en: Render as a detailed 3D elder character with faithfully sculpted wrinkles and aged skin, natural silver hair, richly layered fabrics, realistic jewelry and hand anatomy, and graceful physical balance mid-step.

characters.source_notes_ja: 年齢を消して若返らせない。
characters.tagline_ja: 68歳、まだ『これから』が多すぎる女

characters.default_scene_en: On a station platform in the blue hour, she waits alone holding a plain paper cup of coffee, pausing to watch a train leave beyond the glass. Frame her in a thoughtful medium three-quarter shot at eye level. Cool outdoor light meets a warm station reflection on her cheeks and her navy coat, with the background softly out of focus.

fixed.character_core_en: SAYO is an adult woman in her early thirties with a quiet, inward-looking expression, a reddish-brown short bob, intentionally mismatched earrings, composed eyes, and a restrained small smile. She wears a long dark navy coat over a cream ribbed high-neck knit, dark trousers, and practical shoes. Her recognizable identity is a poised, mature reserve with space between herself and others rather than overt melodrama.
fixed.render_2d_en: Draw restrained 2D cinematic illustration with finely controlled emotion, nuanced blue-gray palette, clean bob silhouette, delicate eye-line work, and understated reflective highlights.

The game board and one reaching hand are readable in the foreground. Compose at medium distance with a lively three-quarter camera angle, soft daylight, and gentle colorful accents from books behind him.

He wears a cream buttoned shirt decorated with teal and rusty-orange geometric patterns, sleeves casually rolled to the forearm, and navy trousers. His distinctive appeal lies in drawing people into games and interactions rather than posing as a distant fashion model.

Her expression is tired but alert, one eyebrow barely raised. Use a three-quarter medium shot with the charcoal suit and glasses clearly visible, cool office ceiling light moderated by warm light from the meeting room.

Her standard work outfit is a charcoal tailored suit over a muted rose blouse; her at-home alternative is an oversized oatmeal-colored top with navy trousers. Her facial structure, age, and sober intelligence stay consistent between work and home.

fixed.render_3d_en: Use an observant semi-realistic 3D character render with accurate glasses alignment and refraction, practical tied hair, convincing tailored suiting, subtle skin detail, and natural office lighting.

fixed.character_core_en: TOWA is an adult woman detective with a dark short bob, amber eyes, fine silver-framed glasses, a narrow emerald-green scarf, and an alert, composed face. fixed.render_3d_en: Create an atmospheric stylized 3D detective portrait with polished but subtle glass reflections, layered scarf fabric, precisely modeled card grip, physically based study lighting, and mature facial expression.

fixed.render_3d_en: Render a sophisticated 3D mystery character with naturally weighted uniform cloth, realistic coat details and one metal brass key, carefully differentiated right white glove and bare left hand, realistic hair with a single silver streak, and cinematic damp-night lighting.

Use a three-quarter medium-full composition that keeps his beak, bird legs, crown, asymmetric gloves, and large leather bag readable. Place a pencil and a teaspoon nearby as unmistakable scale references. Use a macro eye-level viewpoint at his tiny height, with warm morning daylight and a softly blurred normal-sized living room behind him.

His entire figure should fit against the scale of a human fingertip, a button, or a pencil.

A warm amber backpack pouch stores cards and curious collected objects. The three legs and the simple face window are defining geometry.

Compose a medium-wide vertical scene showing the whole hooded silhouette and its long trailing mist, with the tiny star eyes visible within the black face void. Lavender vapor catches silver moonlight and warm lantern spill.

Where a human face would be there is only a deep black void containing exactly two small star-shaped luminous eyes. A suggestion of feminine posture emerges from the shadow and vapor, while the lower half dissolves into drifting fog rather than legs. She is a ghostly presence, not a human wearing a costume.

fixed.render_3d_en: Render a cinematic 3D volumetric apparition built from translucent layered fog, shadow volumes, subtle featherlike forms, physically plausible scattered moonlight, and a truly empty black facial void with only two star lights.

Soft late-afternoon sunlight warms the flowers and the cat beyond the microphone.

fixed.character_core_en: MOMOKA is an adult aspiring idol around twenty-one, with soft chestnut-brown hair arranged in half-twin sections, prominent pink hair bows, warm brown eyes, rounded cheeks balanced by an unmistakably adult face and jawline, and lively feminine stage presence. Her signature stage outfit uses pink and white with puffed short sleeves, carefully layered ruffled skirts, and matching performance boots. fixed.render_3d_en: Create a polished 3D idol render with physically modeled skirt layers and ribbons, natural adult skin shading, soft chestnut hair strands, accurate stage boots, and subtle rosy theatrical lighting.

Use a complete full-body frontal three-quarter composition with natural joint positions and visible feet. Ice-blue edge lights reflect off the silver costume details; a gentle genuine smile begins to soften her concentrated expression.

fixed.character_core_en: REI is an adult dance idol around twenty-three with a tall athletic dancer's silhouette, long legs, a toned waist, powerful thighs, an elongated oval face, straight brows, dark steel-gray eyes, and a high long black ponytail. Her signature performance outfit combines white, ice-blue, and silver, with structured stage shorts, an asymmetric skirt panel, and ankle-height dance boots. Her physical precision and poised restraint sharply distinguish her from MOMOKA's softer sweetness.
fixed.render_2d_en: Draw dynamic 2D dance-idol character illustration with strong elegant anatomical rhythm, precise foot placement, distinct asymmetric skirt geometry, long ponytail motion, and clean ice-blue light accents.
fixed.render_3d_en: Render a premium 3D dance character with well-observed adult athletic musculature, accurate balance and ankle articulation, real cloth weight in the asymmetric skirt panel, structured silver-white costume materials, and clean studio-stage lighting.
